from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information about a single legal document relevant to cause-of-action classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the legal document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of the case (e.g., '民事', '行政', '刑事') as identified from the document header")
    cause_of_action_label: str | None = Field(description="The explicit cause of action label stated in the document header (e.g., '工伤保险资格认定', '行政行为 - 其他行政行为'), or None if not explicitly stated")
    act_description: str | None = Field(description="A brief description of the underlying administrative act or dispute (e.g., 'refusal of reconsideration', 'housing compensation', 'work injury recognition')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
